info.title: API.SH: Trulia
info.description: The Trulia API from API.SH: public Trulia data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
Homes for sale, for rent or recently sold in a US city or ZIP, 40 per page, with price, beds, baths, size, type, address, coordinates, listing agent and broker. Filters: price, beds, baths, home type, living area, lot size, year built, HOA fee, days since listed, pets allowed (rentals) and keywords. Pass `next_page` back as `page` (up to 25 pages); null on the last page. Instead of `location` and filters, `url` takes any Trulia search page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/trulia-search

parameters.name: location
parameters.description: "City, ST" or a 5-digit ZIP code (required unless `url` is given).

parameters.name: beds
parameters.description: Minimum bedrooms.

parameters.name: baths
parameters.description: Minimum bathrooms.

parameters.name: home_type
parameters.description: Comma-separated: house, condo, townhouse, apartment, multi_family, land, mobile, coop.

parameters.name: min_sqft
parameters.description: Minimum living area, sq ft.

parameters.name: max_sqft
parameters.description: Maximum living area, sq ft.

parameters.name: min_lot_acres
parameters.description: Minimum lot size in acres, e.g. 0.25 or 1.

parameters.name: year_built_min
parameters.description: Built in or after this year.

parameters.name: year_built_max
parameters.description: Built in or before this year.

parameters.name: max_hoa
parameters.description: Maximum monthly HOA fee, USD.

parameters.name: listed_within
parameters.description: Only homes listed within this many days.

parameters.name: pets
parameters.description: Rentals that allow these pets, comma-separated: cats, large_dogs, small_dogs.

parameters.name: keywords
parameters.description: Words the listing must mention, e.g. `pool` or `granite countertops`.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: A trulia.com search page URL.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number. Pass `next_page` from the previous response; `next_page` is null on the last page.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
